title: SCOPE: Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise LLM Judging
abstract: arXiv:2602.13110v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as scalable judges in pairwise evaluation, but they remain prone to miscalibration and biases. We propose \textsc{Scope} (Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise Evaluation), a framework that calibrates an acceptance threshold so that, under exchangeability, the error rate among non-abstained judgments is at most a user-specified level $\alpha$. To supply \textsc{Scope} with a bias-neutral uncertainty signal, we introduce Bidirectional Preference Entropy (BPE), which queries the judge under both response positions and converts the order-averaged preference probability into an entropy-based score. Across various pairwise judging benchmarks, BPE outperforms standard confidence proxies in calibration and discrimination, while \textsc{Scope} consistently satisfies the target risk bound (empirical FDR $\approx 0.097$--$0.099$ at $\alpha=0.10$) and retains substantial coverage. translated_title: SCOPE：选择性保形优化的成对LLM评判
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.13110v4 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作成对评估中的可扩展评判者，但它们仍然容易出现校准错误和偏差。我们提出了SCOPE（选择性保形优化的成对评估），一个校准接受阈值的框架，使得在可交换性条件下，非弃权判断中的错误率最多为用户指定的水平α。为了为SCOPE提供无偏见的、中性的不确定性信号，我们引入了双向偏好熵（BPE），该方法在两种响应位置下查询评判者，并将顺序平均的偏好概率转换为基于熵的分数。在各种成对评判基准测试中，BPE在校准和区分度方面优于标准置信度代理，而SCOPE始终满足目标风险界限（在α=0.10时，经验FDR≈0.097-0.099）并保持较高的覆盖率。
tldr: 提出SCOPE框架，通过校准接受阈值和引入双向偏好熵（BPE）信号，确保成对LLM评判在非弃权判断中的错误率受控于用户指定水平，同时优于现有置信度方法。
en_tdlr: Propose the SCOPE framework, which calibrates acceptance thresholds and introduces Bidirectional Preference Entropy (BPE) to control the error rate of non-abstained pairwise LLM judgments at a user-specified level, outperforming existing confidence proxies.
